title: Why your face goes RED when you lift heavy 😤
caption:
You hold your breath and brace, blood pressure shoots up, and your skin opens its vessels to dump heat. Harmless for most. Heart or blood pressure problems? Ask your doctor first. 👇

Why Does This Happen? #5
first_comment: Who else turns tomato red on heavy sets? 🍅
sources: MacDougall JD et al. Arterial blood pressure response to heavy resistance exercise. J Appl Physiol 1985;58:785-790 (mean peak 320/250 mmHg in the double leg press)
Charkoudian N. Skin blood flow in adult human thermoregulation. Mayo Clin Proc 2003;78:603-612
